全家落座，秦婉端上了今天的晚饭，看着几个窝头，一人一碗糊糊，王野问：“娘，咱家没有粮食了吗？”

秦婉无奈的说：“有是有，但是得省着点了，今天去买粮定量又减少了，而且现在还出了一种替代粮，我今天中午试了一下，不是很好，黑乎乎的不知道是什么东西。咱家人口多，必须得省着点吃了，不留着点，心里没底呀！”

王野觉得是时候了，就提议道：“娘，要不我去鸽子市看看吧！现在我和爹上班，以后钱应该是够花的，买点儿高价粮也好呀？”

“还是让你爹去吧，你毕竟还小呢！”

王野正色道：“娘，还是我去吧，我毕竟跟着师傅学了几手，三两个人近不了我的身，退一步说，我还有枪呢！”

秦婉想了想说：“行吧，不过你要是去鸽子市，得答应娘，安全第一，能买到粮就买点，买不到也别强求，咱们省着点，总能熬过去的。”

“放心吧！娘，我心里有数，不会硬来的。”

剩下的时间就成了爹娘的对口相声了，一人一句的跟王野说着鸽子市的注意事项，不能这样，不能那样，鸽子市危险吗？肯定危险。

现在的人都快饿疯了，这要是你背着百八十斤粮食，走不到鸽子市人就没了。同样鸽子市也没那么危险，你要是带着后世价值一千万的古董去，连搭理你的人都没有。现在是特殊时期，粮食的价格在鸽子市上是一涨再涨，而且是有价无市。

吃完晚饭，王野在门口看见赵爷爷刚开始吃饭，就问秦婉：“娘，你看看能不能让赵爷爷来咱家吃饭呀？他一个老头下了班还要做饭，再说了，以前也无所谓了，现在赵爷爷可是我师爷了，咱总得表示表示吧？”

秦婉有点为难：“照理说应该的，可是现在咱家也难啊，粮食不够呀，这猛的加一口，咱家的定量肯定不够。”

王野耐心解释：“娘，你想啥呢？赵爷爷也有定量的。我去和赵爷爷说，让他把粮食拿咱家来，他每天也不用做饭了，下班回来就吃。”

“我这是怕外人说闲话，还以为咱家占你赵爷爷便宜了。”

“娘，闲话肯定会有的，但是咱院里没那种人，而且路遥知马力，日久见人心。咱不让赵爷爷饿着，还比他现在吃的好不就得了。”

秦婉和王铁柱对视了一眼就同意了：“那下来你和你赵爷爷说吧！听听他的意思。”

王野应了一声就去了赵爷爷屋。

“赵爷爷，刚才我和爹娘商量了一下，我们想你以后就在我家吃饭吧！你这每天回来还得做饭挺麻烦的。”

赵爷爷连忙拒绝：“不行不行，这样太麻烦你家了。”

“赵爷爷，这有什么麻烦的，不就是多一双筷子的事儿嘛！先说好啊！我家定量可没你的份，你得带粮食才行。”

“你个臭小子，我说的是粮食的事儿吗！我说的是……”

王野不等赵爷爷说完，就打断了他的话：“赵爷爷，既然说的不是粮食的事儿，那就不是事儿，反正我们吃啥你吃啥。别指望给你开小灶啊！”

“你个臭小子，真是让我说啥好呢！”赵爷爷有些感动了。

“不知道说啥就别说了，您是我师爷，再说您还是看着我长大的呢！从小到大您可没少照顾我，现在我长大了，也是时候开始给您养老了。等我娶了媳妇，给你生个重徒孙子，你也就不用上班了，每天帮我带带孩子，去胡同里下下象棋。跟老....”

刚要说跟老太太们跳跳广场舞，觉得不对，赶紧闭口不说了。

“唉，也是我老头子命好哦，老了老了以为这辈子就这样了。谁能想到找到了衣钵传人，还能享到徒孙的福。”

“赵爷爷，这才哪儿到哪儿啊，享福的日子在后面呢。”

“对对！在后面呢，可我这身体呀，唉...”

王野收起笑脸郑重的说：“赵爷爷，我也正想和你说这事儿呢！我的学习能力你也看见了。我上了一天班，觉得太无聊了。您有没有认识的杏林高手给我介绍介绍，我想学学医术。”

The whole family sat down, and Qin Wan served today's dinner. Looking at several steamed buns, each with a bowl of glutinous rice, Wang Ye asked: "Mom, is our family out of food?"

Qin Wan said helplessly: "Yes, there is, but you have to eat sparingly. The food ration you went to buy today has been reduced again, and now there is a substitute food. I tried it at noon today, and it was not very good. It was so dark that I don't know what it is. We have a large family, so we have to eat sparingly. If we don't save some, I feel unsure!"

Wang Ye thought it was time, so he suggested: "Mom, how about I go to the pigeon market? Now that my father and I are working, we should have enough money to spend in the future. How about buying some high-priced food?"

"Let your father go, you are still young after all!"

Wang Ye said sternly: "Mom, it's better for me to go. After all, I learned a few tricks from my master. Three or two people can't get close to me. To say the least, I still have a gun!"

Qin Wan thought for a while and said, "Okay, but if you go to the pigeon market, you have to promise your mother that safety comes first. If you can buy food, buy it. If you can't buy it, don't force it. Let's save some money and we can get through it."

"Don't worry! Mom, I know what I'm doing and I won't do it forcefully."

The rest of the time became a cross talk between father and mother, each telling Wang Ye the precautions of the Pigeon Market, "Don't do this, don't do that, is the Pigeon City dangerous?"Definitely dangerous.

People are going crazy with hunger now. If you carry 180 kilograms of food on your back, people will die if you don’t reach Pigeon City.Similarly, the pigeon market is not that dangerous. If you go there with antiques worth 10 million in future generations, no one will even talk to you.Now is a special period. The price of food is rising again and again in the pigeon market, and there is no market at all.

After dinner, Wang Ye saw Grandpa Zhao at the door just starting to eat, and asked Qin Wan: "Mom, can you let Grandpa Zhao come to our house for dinner? He is an old man who has to cook after work. Besides, it didn't matter before. Now Grandpa Zhao is my master, we have to show his respect, right?"

Qin Wan was a little embarrassed: "It stands to reason that it should be, but our family is also in trouble now. We don't have enough food. If we add another mouthful, our family's ration will definitely not be enough."

Wang Ye explained patiently: "Mom, what are you thinking about? Grandpa Zhao also has a ration. I'll go and tell Grandpa Zhao to bring the food to our house. He doesn't have to cook every day. He can eat it when he comes back from get off work."

"I'm afraid that outsiders will gossip, and I think our family is taking advantage of your Grandpa Zhao."

"Mom, there will definitely be gossip, but we don't have that kind of people in our courtyard, and the road knows the horse power, and the time knows the people's hearts. If we don't let Grandpa Zhao go hungry, the food he eats better than what he is eating now will be great."

Qin Wan and Wang Tiezhu looked at each other and agreed: "Then come down and talk to your Grandpa Zhao! Listen to what he means."

Wang Ye responded and went to Grandpa Zhao's house.

"Grandpa Zhao, I just discussed it with my parents. We think you can eat at my house from now on! It's quite troublesome for you to have to cook when you come back every day."

Grandpa Zhao quickly refused: "No, no, it's too troublesome for your family."

"Grandpa Zhao, what's the trouble? Isn't it just a matter of getting an extra pair of chopsticks? Let's talk about it first! You don't have a share in my family's ration, so you have to bring food."

"You brat, am I talking about food? What I'm talking about is..."

Wang Ye didn't wait for Grandpa Zhao to finish, and interrupted him: "Grandpa Zhao, since we are not talking about food, it is not a problem. Anyway, you can eat whatever we eat. Don't expect me to open a small stove for you!"

"You stinky boy, you really don't want me to say anything!" Grandpa Zhao was a little moved.

"If you don't know what to say, stop talking. You are my master, and besides, you have watched me grow up! You have taken good care of me since I was a child. Now that I have grown up, it is time to start taking care of you in old age. When I marry a wife and give you a grandson, you will not have to go to work. You will help me take care of my children every day and play chess in the alley. With me..."

I was about to say square dancing with the old ladies, but I felt it was wrong, so I quickly shut up.

"Oh, it's my old man who is lucky. I thought this was the end of my life when I got old. Who would have thought that if I find a successor, I can still enjoy the blessing of being a disciple."

"Grandpa Zhao, where are you now? Your happy days are ahead."

"That's right! It's in the back, but my body, ugh..."

Wang Ye put away his smile and said solemnly: "Grandpa Zhao, I was just about to tell you this! You have also seen my learning ability. I went to class for a day and found it too boring. Is there any Xinglin master you know who you can introduce to me? I want to learn medical skills."
